rows.en:
"·★·☆☆·☆·☆"
The thing shrieked something incomprehensible, spewed a clear, fishy liquid like seawater from between the squirming, writhing tentacles where its mouth should have been, and {f:keeled right over|collapsed hard}.{p}

"Commander!"
Kazama rushed over to the ammonite {f:bastard|monster} and shook it.{p}

"...It's no use. The Commander is dead..."
He muttered that, then glared at {f:me|me}.
"...You tricked me.
You're from the Earth Defense Force, sent here to stop us Sunbararians from invading Earth!
Don't you dare deny it. You tried to worm your way into our ranks, but you failed.
I'm going to kill you!"{p}

...Kazama, help me.
{f:I|I} had no idea you were a real alien!
And what is this Earth Defense Force, anyway?
I never even knew such a thing existed.
Come on, this isn't some TV show...!
The scream in {f:my|my} heart wouldn't come out as a voice.
{f:I|I} {f:could only|could only} tremble, my mouth gaping open and shut.
Kazama came toward {f:me|me} one step at a time, his face terrifying.{p}Wh-what do I do...?!
It's come to this. I have no choice but to fight
Try apologizing, at least
Try to bluff my way out of this somehow
Running is the only option

"Kazama! You've {f:got it wrong|got it all wrong}! That's no Commander!
{f:That guy|That monster} is the enemy spy, {f:dammit|you know}!
{f:It's|It's} a Deberondattan{f:, I tell you|, I'm telling you}!"
"A Deberondattan...?"
Kazama froze.
He looked puzzled.
The lie I'd blurted out on the spot might actually work.
{f:I|I} rattled on without stopping for breath.{p}

"That's right! Didn't you know★
Besides {f:us|us} Sunbararians, there's another race of aliens out to invade Earth.
They're called the Deberondattans. They're terrifying aliens.
They're trying to wipe out every last human on Earth."{p}

Kazama frowned slightly.
Then his eyes fell on the Commander's corpse.
"...How horrible.
All we wanted was to use the humans as food... Wiping them all out is going too far."
{f:You're|You're} both as bad as each other!
...No, that doesn't matter right now{f:.|.}
"Right?! It'd be an absolute waste not to use the humans as food!
So we have to crush the Deberondattans' ambitions!"{p}

Kazama put a hand to his chin and thought it over.
Then he looked at {f:me|me}.
"...Proof?"
"You want... proof?"
"That's right. Let's see some proof.
Proof that this Commander is a Deberondattan, or proof that you're a genuine Sunbararian, either one will do.
In any case, show me proof that you're not a spy for the Earth Defense Force."
...What a turn of events.
I thought Kazama was an idiot, but I never dreamed he'd demand proof...{p}

What now?
What {f:are you gonna do|are you going to do}, {b} {a}?{p}This is the moment of truth{f:!|!}
Show proof that I'm a Sunbararian
Show proof that the Commander is a Deberondattan
Just try dancing

Earlier, when {f:I|I} asked Kazama a similar question, he asked me whether I could drop a ten-yen coin sitting on a piece of paper into a cup{f:.|...}
That's more than enough proof{f:!|!}{p}

"Well? {f:Hurry up and show me the proof|Show me the proof, quick}."
Kazama's eyes turned cold again.
He looked ready to kill {f:me|me} at any second{f:.|.}
...What do I do?
"Showing proof that {f:you're|you're} a Sunbararian is simple.
...All you have to do is take off your mask like this."
"{f:Gyaah|Kyaah}!"
K-Kazama...{p}

Kazama hooked his fingers into the skin of his neck and dragged the skin off his face, slowly peeling it away.
Under the human skin was an ammonite-like head, exactly like the Commander's.{p}
Run
Fight
Apologize
No choice. Try dancing

Well then, {f:guess I'll head home|I think I'll go home}.
Just as {f:I|I} was about to leave the club room...!{p}

"{f:Whoa|Eek}!"
Without thinking, {f:I|I} ducked into the shadows of the club room.{p}

...What {f:the...|is it}...
...{f:What the hell|What}, {f:what the hell|what is this}...
There was something out there just now{f:!|!}
Wasn't that a pack of Sunbararians walking down the hallway toward here{f:?|?}
Was I {f:seeing things|seeing things}?
...No, that's impossible.
Everything was supposed to work out, and there'd be peace...
What do I do?{p}What should I do?
Check one more time
Hide
Make clever use of Kazama's corpse

{f:I|I} ripped the ammonite-like head off Kazama's corpse.
A seawater-like fluid came oozing thickly out of the body.{p}

{f:Ugh|Eww}, gross...
{f:I|I} stared hard at Kazama's head.{p}...Should I {f:try wearing it|try putting it on}?
Put it on
No, forget it

"☆★··☆☆★?"
Right after that, a group of Sunbararians came into the club room and threw some unintelligible words at {f:me|me}.
I had no idea what they were saying.{p}What {f:do I do|should I do}?
Try babbling some gibberish
Silently point at Kazama's corpse
Try showing them the patch-like thing
Just try dancing

{f:I|I} silently pointed at Kazama's headless corpse.
The Sunbararians all let out unintelligible shrieks and began examining Kazama's body.
And the Commander's body, too.
...Now's my chance{f:!|!}{p}

{f:I|I} seized the opening and dashed outside.
No matter what, {f:run|just run}!{p}

Something like a line of white light shot past over {f:my|my} shoulder with tremendous force.
It hit the wall ahead and exploded.{p}

...{f:All right|Okay}, so far so good{f:.|.}
Keep it up{f:.|.}{p}
{f:I|I} took one step out of the school grounds.{p}

...{f:All right|Now}, {f:here goes|now's my chance}.
Run!{p}
{f:I|I} ran with all my might.{p}Where should I go?
My house
The police
The hospital
A TV station

Come to think of it, {f:I|I} still had that disgusting head jammed on.
I'd better take it off.
...Huh?
It won't come off!
I-it won't come off{f:!|!}{p}

Ow, it hurts!
Far from coming off, it hurts horribly when I pull on it.{p}
